caseNameFull: Merriam & Millard Company v. Chicago, Burlington & Quincy Railroad Company
attorneys: Messrs. T. Byron Clark, Bruce Scott and Kenneth F. Burgess for the defendant in error in support of the motion., Messrs. Edward P. Smith and Francis S. Howell for plaintiff in error in opposition to the motion.
